entities.summary: "Let My Love Open the Door" is a song written and performed by the English rock musician Pete Townshend from his third solo studio album Empty Glass (1980). That year, it reached No. 9 on the US Billboard Hot 100 and peaked at No. 5 on the Canadian RPM's Top 100 singles chart.
